sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.work_id,p.first_visible_at_ms FROM (SELECT d.work_id FROM catalog_viewer_grants d WHERE d.actor_id=?1 AND (d.expires_at_us IS NULL OR d.expires_at_us>?5) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_viewer_grant_revocations r WHERE r.grant_id=d.id) UNION SELECT g.work_id FROM catalog_viewer_members m JOIN catalog_viewer_groups grp ON grp.id=m.group_id AND grp.owner_id=m.owner_id JOIN catalog_viewer_grants g ON g.group_id=m.group_id AND g.owner_id=m.owner_id WHERE m.actor_id=?1 AND m.removed=0 AND grp.revoked=0 AND (m.expires_at_us IS NULL OR m.expires_at_us>?5) AND (g.expires_at_us IS NULL OR g.expires_at_us>?5) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_viewer_grant_revocations r WHERE r.grant_id=g.id ) UNION SELECT d.work_id FROM catalog_unit_viewer_grants d WHERE d.actor_id=?1 AND (d.expires_at_us IS NULL OR d.expires_at_us>?5) UNION SELECT g.work_id FROM catalog_viewer_members m JOIN catalog_viewer_groups grp ON grp.id=m.group_id AND grp.owner_id=m.owner_id JOIN catalog_unit_viewer_grants g ON g.group_id=m.group_id AND g.owner_id=m.owner_id WHERE m.actor_id=?1 AND m.removed=0 AND grp.revoked=0 AND (m.expires_at_us IS NULL OR m.expires_at_us>?5) AND (g.expires_at_us IS NULL OR g.expires_at_us>?5)) c JOIN catalog_metadata_publication_pointers p ON p.work_id=c.work_id LEFT JOIN catalog_viewer_policies policy ON policy.work_id=p.work_id JOIN catalog_works w ON w.id=p.work_id JOIN catalog_metadata_generations generation ON generation.work_id=p.work_id AND generation.generation=p.generation WHERE p.lifecycle='active' AND (policy.audience='restricted' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_unit_viewer_policies up WHERE up.work_id=p.work_id AND up.mode='restricted')) AND w.lifecycle<>'archived' AND (?6 IS NULL OR generation.kind=?6) AND (?7 IS NULL OR generation.language=?7) AND (?8='' OR instr(generation.search_text,?8)>0) AND (?2 IS NULL OR p.first_visible_at_ms<?2 OR (p.first_visible_at_ms=?2 AND p.work_id>?3)) ORDER BY p.first_visible_at_ms DESC,p.work_id ASC LIMIT ?4

SELECT release_id FROM (SELECT x.release_id,x.work_id,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.work_id ORDER BY x.published_at DESC,x.release_id ASC) AS pick FROM audio_listener_releases x
JOIN audio_listener_works anchor ON anchor.work_id=x.work_id
JOIN audio_listener_units ordering ON ordering.unit_id=x.unit_id AND ordering.work_id=x.work_id
JOIN audio_publication_pointers pointer ON pointer.unit_id=x.unit_id AND pointer.active_release_id=x.release_id
JOIN audio_releases rel ON rel.id=x.release_id AND rel.unit_id=x.unit_id AND rel.owner_id=pointer.owner_id
JOIN audio_release_candidates candidate ON candidate.id=rel.candidate_id AND candidate.owner_id=rel.owner_id
JOIN audio_renditions rendition ON rendition.id=rel.rendition_id AND rendition.id=candidate.rendition_id
JOIN audio_submissions submission ON submission.id=rendition.submission_id AND submission.owner_id=rel.owner_id AND submission.unit_id=x.unit_id
JOIN audio_distribution_clearances clearance ON clearance.candidate_id=candidate.id AND clearance.owner_id=rel.owner_id AND clearance.digest=x.rights_digest
  AND clearance.sequence=(SELECT max(c2.sequence) FROM audio_distribution_clearances c2 WHERE c2.candidate_id=candidate.id AND c2.owner_id=rel.owner_id)
JOIN audio_publication_approvals approval ON approval.candidate_id=candidate.id AND approval.owner_id=rel.owner_id AND approval.digest=x.approval_digest
  AND approval.sequence=(SELECT max(a2.sequence) FROM audio_publication_approvals a2 WHERE a2.candidate_id=candidate.id AND a2.owner_id=rel.owner_id)
WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_metadata_publication_pointers gp JOIN catalog_metadata_generation_entries ge ON ge.work_id=gp.work_id AND ge.generation=gp.generation JOIN catalog_metadata_generation_audio ga ON ga.work_id=ge.work_id AND ga.generation=ge.generation AND ga.unit_id=ge.unit_id JOIN catalog_works gw ON gw.id=gp.work_id JOIN catalog_units gu ON gu.id=ge.unit_id AND gu.work_id=gw.id WHERE gp.work_id=x.work_id AND gp.lifecycle='active' AND gw.lifecycle<>'archived' AND gu.lifecycle<>'archived' AND ge.unit_id=x.unit_id AND ga.release_id=x.release_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_unit_viewer_policies uv WHERE uv.unit_id=ge.unit_id AND uv.mode<>'inherit') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_viewer_policies vp WHERE vp.work_id=gp.work_id AND vp.audience<>'public')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM actors owner_actor WHERE owner_actor.id=rel.owner_id AND owner_actor.active=1)
AND x.rights_start<=?1 AND ?1<x.rights_end AND x.published_at<=?1
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audio_release_withdrawals w WHERE w.release_id=rel.id)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audio_submission_revocations v WHERE v.submission_id=submission.id)
 AND x.work_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2))) selected WHERE pick=1 ORDER BY work_id
